blocks.text: Seven impact indicators, twenty-five outcome indicators and thirty-six output indicators measure the plan, each with a definition, a source, an owner and a frequency.

Tier 1 measures the 2035 case and is reported to the Board. Tier 2 measures the focus areas, one or two each, and is reported to Steerco each quarter where the source allows. Tier 3 measures the initiatives' own outputs and is reported by the leads to the programme office each month. The full register, with targets, sits in the toolkit (section 5.7).
